name: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend)
aliases: GPU Volume Ray Casting with VTK
VTK OpenGL GPU Volume Ray Cast Mapper
VTK GPU Volume Ray Casting Setup
definition: A hardware-accelerated volume rendering technique using VTK's vtkGPUVolumeRayCastMapper with composite blending mode to render 3D medical datasets (CT/MRI) by accumulating color and opacity along rays.
summary: GPU Volume Ray Casting (VTK Composite Blend) is a direct volume rendering technique that offloads ray casting to the GPU for performance while supporting accurate VTK lighting models and adaptive shading.
